business_summary.text: Sudeep Pharma is a specialty chemicals company producing mineral-based excipients and ingredients for pharma, food and nutrition, and specialty ingredient markets, and is building a battery-materials (iron phosphate) business through Sudeep Advanced Materials.

call_points.text: NSS is targeted to reach margins similar to core specialty ingredients by FY28.
Sudeep Advanced Materials Phase 1 commissioning targeted for April 2027; long-lead equipment deliveries complete this October.
Navsari greenfield: FDA approval expected this quarter, supplies to start Q3; five food-nutra customers approving the site.
Phosphate demand exceeds current capacity, giving visibility for the balance of FY27.
Bisglycinate Q1 sales already surpassed the whole of FY26; two large North American customers approved.
Battery materials: 7 customers completed validation and are in active off-take talks; two binding agreements targeted later this year.
Phosphoric acid prices rose ~50% in Q1 on higher sulfur; pass-through expected to largely offset in Q2.
NSS faces a customer scaling down operations in Ireland due to energy costs; FY27 may be flattish with single-digit growth.
Asset turns at scale for battery and greenfield expected at 2.7-3x.
Pharma food and nutrition expected to grow faster than FY26's 10%; specialty to track its recent growth rate.
Greenfield plant has completed internal validation and started customer approval, which takes six to 12 months.
Battery materials Phase 1 of 25,000 metric tons per year at Dahej remains on track for April 2027.
Around 51 new customer approvals received in FY26, expected to drive FY27 growth.
Phosphoric acid price increases were passed on to customers only in Q1, so benefits show up progressively in Q1 and Q2.
Net debt was ₹33.6 Cr at 31 March 2026, with net debt-to-equity of 0.04x.

operating_notes.text: Pharma food and nutrition capacity utilisation is 65-70%; specialty ingredients 35-40%.
Battery materials: 42 customers engaged, 22 at lab validation, 14 at pilot scale, six completed commercial validation; 700 metric tons of orders received in the last month.
Existing battery-grade iron phosphate capacity of 5,000-7,000 tons is being used to service orders, with a goal of 50% for commercial orders and 50% for customer validation.
Phosphoric acid prices rose ~50% during Q1FY27 due to higher sulfur prices; pass-through expected to largely offset in Q2.
Bisglycinate sales in Q1FY27 surpassed total FY26 sales; two large North American customers approved.
Battery materials: 7 customers completed validation and are in active off-take discussions; 21 at lab validation, 16 at pilot-scale.

timeline.summary: Sudeep Pharma's Q4/FY26 earnings call (22 May 2026) reported FY26 revenue up 27.9% to ₹642.3 Cr and guided FY27 EBITDA margin back to 37-38%.

On 5 August 2026, Sudeep Pharma held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting 27% YoY revenue growth to ₹158.3 Cr and guiding to 37-38% EBITDA margins, with battery-materials Phase 1 commissioning targeted for April 2027.
